blogs.title: How to keep your Gmail Account Secure?
blogs.title_hi: अपने जीमेल अकाउंट को सुरक्षित कैसे रखें?
blogs.content:
Like every other email servers, Google’s systems are also prone to cyber attack. To neutralize
these actions, one has to stay updated with the security features and suggestions provided by
Gmail.
Among the few easiest steps in this regard, the preliminary one is not to disclose your login
credentials. Any emails or text inquiring such details should be ignored immediately. Any email
servers including Gmail would never request such information explicitly form users. Further one
should be in practice of changing passwords frequently. Gmail too recommends changing your
password twice a year at least without repeating the previous passwords in the span of six
months.

blogs.title: Microsoft Security Essential
blogs.content: The biggest threat any person with a system has is that of a virus. But what is this virus actually? A virus is the child of one of the greatest brains Steve Jobs. Once virus attacks became common Microsoft joint hands with Norton to produce world’s first antivirus- a software aimed at finding and treating the viruses. Sensing the opportunity of tremendous growth, any more companies jumped into the market of antivirus manufacturing and started selling their product. blogs.title: What is a .Dat file in windows?
blogs.content:
Sometimes you might have received an email containing an attachment with .Dat extension, and then you must have questioned yourself that “What is .Dat file”. Further you might have asked that how to excess this particular file. So, let’s have a look at solution to those frequent doubts.
The very first thing that .Dat file indicates is that it contains some random data and it is not designed to be used by some specific applications. It means unlike the case of some frequently used file, let’s say seeing an XLS file one can easily say that it should be opened by Microsoft Excel, but in case of .Dat file you yourself have to decide that with which program you must open that file. It can be different programs at different times.

blogs.title: Does Your Computer Keep Freezing Too?
blogs.title_hi: क्या आपका कंप्यूटर बहुत धीमा रहता है?
blogs.content:
Is your computer freezing too?

If you are in search of an answer to “Why does my computer keep freezing” then simply sit back and relax; as your problem is fixable. It is not a serious issue. Most often freezing of your computer system indicates that something is going wrong inside, and it demands fixing before it turns out into a big problem. Although freezing is a very common phenomenon which must have been experienced by most of the computer users, it shouldn’t be overlooked. The sooner you sort out the issue, the better it will prove for your system. So from next time whenever your computer system freezes, need not to panic as you know it can be easily resolved.

blogs.title_hi: मैं AWS EC2 Ubuntu 16.04 मशीन पर Nginx कैसे स्थापित कर सकता हूं और एकाधिक वेबसाइट होस्ट करता हूं।
blogs.content:
Nginx ( /ˌɛndʒɪnˈɛks/ EN-jin-EKS[8]) (stylized as NGINX, NGiИX or nginx) is a web server which can also be used as a reverse proxy, load balancer, mail proxy and HTTP cache. The software was created by Igor Sysoev and first publicly released in 2004. A company of the same name was founded in 2011 to provide support and Nginx plus paid software.

Nginx is free and open-source software, released under the terms of a BSD-like license. A large fraction of web servers use NGINX, often as a load balancer.

Bangalore (/bæŋɡəˈlɔːr/), officially known as Bengaluru ([ˈbeŋɡəɭuːɾu] ( listen)), is the capital of the Indian state of Karnataka.
